title: Pareto Support Proofs: exact certificates and standalone verification
description: This source engine is version 0.6.2 and is included in the published OPTL-R1-20261017 companion, released on 17 October 2026 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23440598). The DOI identifies the complete companion distribution rather than a later source-only snapshot. Retained examples, results, protocol and validation files belong to historical engine 0.6.1 and are not outputs of this successor. An exact certificate generator, a standalone generator-independent checker, machine-readable schemas, canonical proof objects and retained computational evidence for non-negative weighted-sum supportability and unsupportedness in finite multi-objective optimisation. Negative certificates are checked with exact rational arithmetic. Positive certificate objects distinguish fully checkable adapters from binary-linear objects that retain an explicitly declared trusted-oracle boundary.
